text:
Asha (CS): FYI CedarPoint renewal hitting a few procurement snags: PO references the old entity name and AP wants a tax-exempt certificate attached. Signer on PO is "Head of Ops" but contract needs CFO sign or delegation. Need a quick workaround to avoid a 72hr delay.
Liam (Sales): Marta said they can upload docs but CFO is OOO until tomorrow. AP will only pay if we accept a tax-exempt cert and the PO matches billing entity. PO number: CP-2026-770
Marta (CedarPoint): Sorry for the churn
AP system still uses CedarPoint Health LLC. Our legal entity recently changed to CedarPoint Global Ltd. Uploading PO and tax-exempt cert now.
Marta (CedarPoint): PO uploaded: https://files.cedarpoint.example/CP-2026-770.pdf
Marta (CedarPoint): Tax-exempt certificate: https://files.cedarpoint.example/tax_exempt_2026.pdf
Noah (Finance): We can accept a tax-exempt cert but need the PO entity to either match the contract or have a short email from CFO mapping the old PO entity to the contract entity. An emailed mapping + tax-exempt doc should let us invoice.
Greta (Legal): For the signer, interim "Head of Ops" is OK if the CFO provides delegation. Email delegation acceptable: "I, [CFO name], authorize [Head of Ops] to sign renewals for CedarPoint Global Ltd dated [date]."
Marta (CedarPoint): Sending delegation via reply-all now.
Marta (CedarPoint): "I, Elena Park (CFO), authorize Samir Khan (Head of Ops) to sign renewals for CedarPoint Global Ltd dated 2026-03-28." Attached signed PDF.
Noah (Finance): Got delegation and tax cert. I will accept the PO provided the invoice field shows exactly CP-2026-770 and we add a memo: "Old entity: CedarPoint Health LLC mapped to CedarPoint Global Ltd per CFO email 2026-03-28."
Asha (CS): Creating DocuSign envelope env-cp-770 and adding the memo + tax cert link in the appendix. Resent to Samir. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env-cp-770
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env-cp-770 status=sent
Marta (CedarPoint): Samir signing now.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env-cp-770 status=completed
Billing Bot: Invoice created referencing CP-2026-770, tax-exempt flag applied, charge date 2026-04-05.
Noah (Finance): I'll process but note: since tax-exempt, AP will still require a verified certificate on file; please confirm we store the cert in AR.
Asha (CS): Confirmed, cert and CFO email saved to contract folder. Noting risk: entity renames and AP systems often cause 1-3 day delays; recommend capturing legal entity + tax status during the renewal outreach. :memo:
Liam (Sales): Agreed. I'll update the renewal checklist.
Marta (CedarPoint): Huge thanks, team
Asha (CS): Marking renewal complete in CRM and opening seat provisioning ticket.
